title: Sword Trims
description: Adds trims to swords. Each trim gives special abilities!
body:
**This plugin was made as a commission for [ManticThor](https://www.youtube.com/@manticthor), go check out his channel!**

I am open for plugin and mod commissions, my Discord is `serpyfn`. Also DM me if there are any issues :)

# Sword Trims

Echo Shards, while rare, are currently mostly useless. This plugin changes that, allowing users to apply trims to swords and granting them unique abilities!

## Dynamic

Craft 5 echo shards into a sword shard in a cross pattern on the crafting table.

Surround an armor trim (e.g. Silence) with 4 sword shards in a cross pattern with the trim in the middle. This will create a Trim Shard.

Apply the Trim Shard onto a sword on an anvil and the sword will grant powers.

## Trims

| Trim | Location | Type | Effect |
|------|----------|------|--------|
| Flow | Trial Chambers | Passive | Resistance 1 for 15 seconds while holding the sword |
| Bolt | Trial Chambers | Passive | 10% chance per hit to heal 2.5 hearts |
| Sentry | Pillager Outpost | Aggressive | 10% chance per hit to summon a temporary illusion of a Pillager ally for 30 seconds |
| Dune | Desert Pyramid | Aggressive | 10% chance per crit to give Strength 1 for 10 seconds |
| Coast | Shipwreck | Passive | Dolphin's Grace 1 while holding the sword |
| Wild | Jungle Temple | Aggressive | 30% chance per crit to poison target for 30 seconds (stacks) |
| Tide | Ocean Monument | Passive | Water Breathing 1 while holding the sword |
| Ward | Ancient City | Passive | Night Vision 1 while holding the sword |
| Vex | Woodland Mansion | Passive | Speed 1 while holding the sword |
| Rib | Nether Fortress | Aggressive | Deal 2 extra hearts of damage against mobs in the Nether while using the sword |
| Snout | Bastion Remnant | Passive | Damages other entities that have attacked the player while holding the sword |
| Eye | Stronghold | Aggressive | 10% chance per crit to apply Weakness to target for 10 seconds (stacks) |
| Spire | End City | Aggressive | Extra 2 hearts damage to all mobs when in the End |
| Silence | Ancient City | Aggressive | Critical hits deal +1.5 hearts extra damage while holding the sword |
| Wayfinder | Trail Ruins | Passive | Reveals nearby structures and chests within 30 blocks while holding the sword |
| Raiser | Trail Ruins | Aggressive | 10% chance per crit to launch a shockwave that deals 1 heart of damage every tick for 5 ticks when attacked while holding the sword |
| Shaper | Trail Ruins | Passive | Increases attack speed by 10% |
| Host | Trail Ruins | Passive | Regeneration 3 while fighting someone while holding the sword |
